note: The complete relevant MINI sections of one full lecture-note treatment and one full textbook were inspected. They support the MINI pair and stationary Stokes context only. The velocity and accumulated-pressure sensor inequalities are proved locally as consequences of the exact inspected smooth-branch supplier statements; no instantaneous pressure rate is inferred.

sources.title: Jean-Luc Guermond, MATH 661 Fall 2025, Chapter 54: Stokes equations: Stable pairs (I)
sources.locator: Complete 12-page chapter inspected; §54.2, Lemma 54.5 and Remark 54.6, printed pp. 410–413 (PDF pp. 3–6).

contents.name: §54.2: P1-bubble/P1 MINI spaces and Lemma 54.5 uniform inf-sup stability

source_review.read_extent: Inspected the complete §54.2 space definition and Lemma 54.5 proof, including its Fortin construction and inf-sup conclusion.
source_review.supports: The continuous P1 pressure with one interior P1 bubble per simplex in each velocity component is uniformly inf-sup stable under the stated shape-regular affine-mesh and full Dirichlet hypotheses.
source_review.limitations: The source treats the Stokes pair; it does not prove the nonlinear backward Euler velocity estimate or any pressure-observation error.

contents.name: Remark 54.6: stationary Stokes MINI convergence rate

source_review.read_extent: Inspected the complete Remark 54.6 statement and its stated H2-velocity/H1-pressure and MINI hypotheses.
source_review.supports: Stationary mixed Stokes approximation supplies the spatial approximation context used transitively by the current velocity supplier.
source_review.limitations: This stationary estimate is not the smooth evolutionary velocity estimate and does not imply pressure-primitive convergence.
